description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView for displaying log messages by implementing the LogNode interface. It formats and appends log entries, including handling exceptions, and supports chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays formatted log messages received through the LogNode interface, supporting chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats a log message with priority, tag, message, and optional throwable, then displays it in the LogView and passes it to the next log node if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to the StringBuilder if it is not null, with optional delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
